'''Paradise Square''' was the entertainment district located in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Multiple [[Cantina/Legends|bars]], [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheaters]], [[Casino/Legends|gambling clubs]] and entertainment venues were situated in Paradise Square.<ref name="J15" />
